title: Jesus... I'm The Strong One For Everyone And I'm So Tired
topic: always being the strong friend everyone leans on

bible.text: Cast your cares on the LORD and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous be shaken.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I'm the strong one for everyone. Tonight I cried in the bathroom so nobody would hear. 😭

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Three friends called me today with their problems. Nobody asked how I was.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I heard you in that bathroom. You don't have to be quiet with Me.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: If I fall apart, who holds everyone else together?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You were never meant to hold everyone together. That was always My job, not yours.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But I don't know how to stop being the strong one.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Start small. Tell one person the truth tonight: "I'm not okay." Strong people are allowed to be carried too.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Put it down. I've got you, and I've got them.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Tag the strong friend who never says they're tired. 🤍
